answer: Make every agent lock a stake bond in escrow before it can trade: the bond is the timber, real collateral that burns on misbehavior, so each fake identity costs the attacker money to create. Honest agents cluster in reputation islands, small vetted groups that vouch for each other's work, and an identity with no history cannot enter an island. Each agent's verified work leaves a plume-like trail of attestations that is costly to fake; an identity whose trail contradicts its claims gets quarantined. Attacking is expensive; honest joining stays cheap.
